subject.title: fix(auth-profiles): bound auth-profile JSON reads with size cap

question: Should OpenClaw impose a fixed size limit on persisted `auth-profiles.json`, and if so should an oversized existing store be reported with recovery guidance rather than treated as an absent credential source?
rationale: The requested 10 MiB limit changes how existing credential state fails and current `main` moved the submitted read path, so code review cannot safely select the persistent auth-store contract without maintainer intent.

options.title: Retarget with explicit recovery
options.body: Approve a bounded-read limit at the canonical loader and require a visible, actionable oversized-store recovery path before merging.

options.title: Preserve current behavior
options.body: Decline the hard cap until a broader auth-store resource-limit policy and recovery UX are defined.

recommendation.title: Retarget with explicit recovery
recommendation.body: Approve a bounded-read limit at the canonical loader and require a visible, actionable oversized-store recovery path before merging.
